'''Havoc''', designated '''CT-9529''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:AhsokaBarrisVsHavocTrap-BI.png|thumb|left|200px|Havoc and Trap are held at bay by Tano and Offee]]
Havoc, along with the rest of Tango Company, served at the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], and afterwards was sent on a medical supply run to [[Ord Cestus]]. While aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] supply ship that was being transported back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], he heard the sound of blaster shots in the mess hall. He rushed in to investigate with the leader of Tango Company, [[Trap/Legends|Trap]], only to be interrogated by Ahsoka and Barriss, the two having just survived an attack by two other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Ox/Legends|Ox]] and [[Edge/Legends|Edge]]. Once Havoc and Trap convinced the Jedi that they were not their enemies, the four attempted to contact the bridge via comlink but failed to receive any response. As a result, the Jedi left to inspect the bridge, instructing Havoc to stay behind to watch over the unconscious Ox and Edge.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

While Ahsoka and Barriss were away, Havoc fell prey to the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]] that had stowed aboard the ship and was subsequently mind-controlled, just as Ox and Edge had been. Later he along with [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] and Edge, pinned down the [[Unidentified clone trooper (TB-73)|final uninfected clone trooper]] on the ship and infected him with a brain worm. Immediately afterwards, he and the rest of the clones were forced to attack the Jedi that had been watching the act. The Jedi escaped using the ventilation system, and in spite of capturing and infecting Barriss, Havoc along with the rest of the crew were finally sterilized when Ahsoka ruptured the ship's cooling tanks killing the brain worms.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Human/Legends|human]] clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Havoc was 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) tall.<ref name="Clone Databank" /> Havoc had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin, and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], with longer sideburns and facial hair in the form of a goatee.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Equipment==
Havoc carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], and a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. He wore Phase I Armor that had blue markings and bore a striped sigil on his armored shoulder plates that resembled a stylized tiger face.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
